title: Let gratitude become honest again
summary: Let honest thanks stay tender enough to notice the gift before the complaint. Keep this close: Keep this in front of you: honest gratitude becomes the doorway to mercy and Naam.
lifeApplication: Before complaining about what is missing, name one mercy already resting in the room and let it become praise.

source.shortMeaning: Honest gratitude opens the heart to mercy and living Naam.
source.lifeApplication: Before sleep, confess one gift you treated as ordinary and thank the Giver.
